project: ASC3ND Month 1 Shot List + Visual Direction
brand_reference: Collins (wearecollins.com) — Swiss-modernist grids, named systems, declarative tone, generous negative space

shot_list.subject: Otha & Elisha Minnifield seated interview
shot_list.capture_notes: Clean audio, room tone, 3-camera setup if possible

shot_list.subject: Leadership workshop/activity
shot_list.capture_notes: Action shots, engagement, focus on hands and faces

shot_list.subject: Community Cuts for Kids event — families arriving
shot_list.capture_notes: Arrival energy, welcome table, check-in process

shot_list.subject: Haircuts in progress
shot_list.capture_notes: No child faces without explicit media consent. Focus on hands, scissors, smiles from behind

shot_list.subject: Founder portraits (Otha and Elisha)
shot_list.capture_notes: Warm, confident, approachable. Natural light preferred

shot_list.subject: Post-event: full backpacks, smiling families leaving
shot_list.capture_notes: Impact without exploitation. Focus on supplies and confidence, not poverty

visual_direction.philosophy: Impact without exploitation. Confidence without arrogance. Community without tokenization.
do: Focus on hands, supplies, haircuts, smiles
Capture the energy of community gathering
Frame for mobile-first (9:16 primary, then square, then 16:9)
dont: Show child faces without explicit media consent
Use poverty or hardship as spectacle
Film sensitive youth stories or medical information
Use stock photography as documentary evidence

framing_guide.vertical_9x16: Primary format for Stories, Reels, TikTok

visual_direction.color_grading: Warm, natural. Gold accent for CTAs and highlights. Paper background for text overlays. No teal, no purple, no gradients.
